verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents API tokens scoped to specific resources and permission levels, for example Zone DNS Read limited to a single zone. Its recommended MCP server lets users pick the permissions granted to an agent via OAuth, or pass a purpose-built API token as a bearer credential, and a live probe confirms that server is OAuth-gated. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped agent tokens are enforced as least-privilege in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Select which resources the token is authorized to access.
granting Zone DNS Read access to a zone example.com will allow the token to read DNS records only for that specific zone
After selecting a permissions group (Account, User, or Zone), choose what level of access to grant the token.
you will be redirected to Cloudflare to authorize via OAuth and select the permissions to grant to your agent
you can create a Cloudflare API token with the permissions you need and pass it as a bearer token in the Authorization header
